rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person's ability or general capacity.

example.english: I have the ability to finish this work.
example.traditional: 我有能力完成呢份工作
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 nang4 lik6 jyun4 sing4 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Choose this for someone's practical competence or knack, especially in casual speech.

example.english: You really have the ability to handle such a difficult dish.
example.traditional: 你真係有本事，咁難嘅菜都整得掂
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 bun2 si6 gam3 naan4 ge3 coi3 dou1 zing2 dak1 dim6

rows.note: Use this for a device, system, or product's built-in capability or function.

example.english: This washing machine has the ability to dry clothes automatically.
example.traditional: 呢部洗衣機有自動烘乾功能
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sai2 ji1 gei1 jau5 zi6 dung6 hung1 gon1 gung1 nang4

rows.note: Choose this when the ability means natural talent or aptitude rather than a learned skill.

example.english: My teacher said I had a lot of natural ability in drawing.
example.traditional: 老師話我喺畫畫方面好有天分
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 waa6 ngo5 hai2 waa6 waa2 fong1 min6 hou2 jau5 tin1 fan6
